name: Frontier Airlines
cargo_notes: Frontier does not carry pets as checked baggage or cargo. Cabin only.
international_notes: Frontier is not accepting new pets for international travel. Only service animals may fly internationally (service dogs must meet CDC dog import rules).

verification.notes: Fee ($149 per pet, per direction, non-refundable) is from flyfrontier.com/optional-services. Carrier sizes, 1 pet per container, 1 pet per passenger, species and the international rule are from the Family & Pets page and faq.flyfrontier.com/help/do-you-allow-pets-on-the-plane. No weight limit is stated on any official page, so max_weight_lbs stays null.

name: Southwest Airlines
cargo_notes: Southwest does not carry pets as checked baggage or cargo. Cabin only.
international_notes: No pets on international flights or any itinerary that includes one. No pets on flights to/from Hawaii; pets are accepted between Hawaiian islands ($35 per carrier one-way).

verification.notes: Fee is $125 one-way per pet CARRIER (not per pet) on the mainland, $35 interisland Hawaii, per southwest.com/html/customer-service/travel-fees.html. Carrier limit 18 x 10.5 x 10 in comes from support.southwest.com 'What type of pet carriers can I bring' and is not split by hard/soft, so the same value is used for both (soft-sided recommended; Southwest's own carrier is 15 x 10 x 10 in). One carrier per ticketed customer, up to two small same-species cats or dogs. No weight limit stated, so null.

name: Spirit Airlines
cargo_notes: Spirit does not transport pets in cargo at any time. Cabin only.
international_notes: No animals on international flights except service animals. Domestic flights include Puerto Rico and St. Thomas, USVI (rabies certificate required for Puerto Rico; health certificate required for USVI).

verification.notes: Spirit's help page and Contract of Carriage (Apr 30 2026, section 6.2) say there is a charge per pet carrier but give no amount; the amount is on spirit.com/optional-services, which could not be retrieved (blocks automated access). $125 each way from third-party guides is unconfirmed, so fee and fee_basis are null. Neither official page states a weight limit, so the third-party 40 lb figure was removed (null = not stated). Contract of Carriage also says max 6 pet containers per cabin.
